summary: Faster consent analysis and a cleaner Alignment Report.

updates.title: Consent Rate by Default
updates.body: Per-source charts now default to consent rate, with a volume toggle and count tooltips for faster analysis.

updates.title: Alignment Report Filters
updates.body: The "Consent in review" filter and review dates are now hidden when no authorization source is configured.

updates.title: Consent per Data Source
updates.body: The visual now uses actual consent values and lets you unselect a data partner.

updates.title: Alignment Report Drawer
updates.body: The popout drawer now shows the CRx ID instead of the patient SID.
